# Configuration

`sluice serve --config <file>` reads the server config, a YAML file.

An environment variable overrides a key: `SLUICE_REST__LISTEN` sets `rest.listen`.
These keys must also be in the file, or Sluice ignores the variable: `mcp.listen`, `admin.token`, `duckdb.tempDir`, `identity.apiKeyPepper`.
The same holds for all keys under `rest.tls`, `admin.tls`, `audit.file`, `audit.syslog`, `audit.s3`.
No variable sets `approval.webhooks`.
[Server config](../operations/server-config.md) explains this rule and secret references.

A key with an empty default is a string. Write a time like its default: `30s`, `5m`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rest.listen` | `:8080` | REST API address. |
| `rest.tls.certFile` |  | Certificate file. Needs `keyFile`. |
| `rest.tls.keyFile` |  | Key file. Needs `certFile`. |
| `rest.tls.clientCA` |  | CA file. Clients must send a certificate. |
| `rest.tls.clientAuth` |  | Only `require_and_verify`. Needs `clientCA`. |
| `rest.maxBodyBytes` | `1048576` | Largest request body. |
| `rest.requestTimeout` | `30s` | Time limit of a request. |
| `mcp.enabled` | `false` | Start MCP in `sluice serve`. |
| `mcp.transport` | `stdio` | `stdio` or `streamable_http`. |
| `mcp.listen` |  | Address for `streamable_http`. Empty means `:80`. |
| `mcp.sessionIdleMax` | `30m` | HTTP idle timeout. |
| `mcp.tokenRef` |  | Secret reference: JWT for `stdio`. |
| `mcp.apiKeyRef` |  | Secret reference: API key for `stdio`. |
| `mcp.allowAnonymous` | `false` | Accept clients without a credential. |
| `admin.enabled` | `false` | Start the admin API. |
| `admin.listen` | `:9091` | Admin API address. |
| `admin.token` |  | Bearer token, plain text. Empty means no check. |
| `admin.tls.certFile` |  | Certificate file. Needs `keyFile`. |
| `admin.tls.keyFile` |  | Key file. Needs `certFile`. |
| `admin.tls.clientCA` |  | CA file. Clients must send a certificate. |
| `admin.tls.clientAuth` |  | Only `require_and_verify`. Needs `clientCA`. |
| `duckdb.memoryLimit` | `4GB` | DuckDB `memory_limit`. |
| `duckdb.threads` | `0` | DuckDB `threads`. `0` means the DuckDB default. |
| `duckdb.tempDir` |  | DuckDB `temp_directory`. |
| `duckdb.maxOpen` | `4` | Maximum open connections. |
| `duckdb.maxIdle` | `2` | Maximum idle connections. |
| `duckdb.connMaxIdle` | `5m` | Idle time before a connection closes. |
| `datasources.failFast` | `true` | Stop at start when a data source fails. |
| `policies.directory` | `./policies.d` | The policy directory. |
| `policies.reload` | `true` | Reload when a file changes. |
| `policies.engine` | `yaml` | `yaml`, `opa` or `composite`. |
| `policies.composite.members` | `[yaml]` | `yaml`, `opa`, `rebac`. |
| `policies.opa.moduleDir` |  | Directory of the `.rego` files. |
| `policies.opa.query` | `data.sluice.main` | Rego query for the decision. |
| `policies.rebac.cacheTtl` | `10s` | Lifetime of a cached check. |
| `policies.rebac.cacheSize` | `10000` | Maximum cached checks. |
| `audit.file.path` |  | Audit log directory. Empty means `sluice-audit` in the temp directory. |
| `audit.file.rotateDaily` | `false` | New file each UTC day. Always on when `rotateSizeMB` is `0`. |
| `audit.file.rotateSizeMB` | `0` | New file after this size. |
| `audit.file.genesis` |  | Secret reference: genesis. |
| `audit.syslog.network` | `udp` | `udp`, `tcp`, `unix` or `unixgram`. |
| `audit.syslog.address` |  | Required. `host:port` or socket path. |
| `audit.syslog.facility` | `local0` | `kern`, `user`, `daemon`, `auth`, `syslog`, `local0` to `local7`. |
| `audit.syslog.tag` | `sluice` | Syslog app name. |
| `audit.s3.endpoint` | `s3.amazonaws.com` | S3 host. |
| `audit.s3.bucket` |  | Required. |
| `audit.s3.prefix` | `audit/` | Object key prefix. |
| `audit.s3.region` |  | S3 region. |
| `audit.s3.insecure` | `false` | Use HTTP, not HTTPS. |
| `audit.s3.forcePathStyle` | `false` | Path-style URLs. |
| `audit.s3.objectLock` |  | `governance` or `compliance`. Needs `retentionDays`. |
| `audit.s3.retentionDays` | `0` | Lock time in days. |
| `audit.s3.credentialsRef` |  | Secret reference: JSON with `accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey`. |
| `audit.s3.uploadInterval` | `30s` | Longest time between uploads. |
| `audit.s3.uploadBytes` | `1048576` | Batch size that starts an upload. |
| `audit.s3.maxBufferBytes` | `8388608` | Buffer size. More records are dropped. |
| `audit.failClosed` | `true` | Refuse queries when the audit log fails. |
| `audit.sqlSampleBytes` | `2048` | SQL bytes in an audit record. |
| `logging.level` | `info` | `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. |
| `logging.format` | `json` | `json` or `text`. |
| `logging.maxErrorBytes` | `4096` | Cut logged errors at this size. `0` means no cut. |
| `tracing.enabled` | `false` | Send OpenTelemetry traces. |
| `tracing.endpoint` |  | OTLP `host:port`. Required when enabled. |
| `tracing.protocol` | `grpc` | `grpc` or `http`. |
| `tracing.insecure` | `false` | Send without TLS. |
| `tracing.sampleRatio` | `1` | Share of traces sent, 0 to 1. |
| `identity.apiKeyPepper` |  | Secret reference: pepper for API key hashes. |
| `limits.maxRows` | `100000` | Row limit when the request sets none. |
| `limits.maxRowsCeiling` | `100000` | Highest row limit a request can set. |
| `limits.maxSqlBytes` | `1048576` | Largest SQL text. |
| `limits.queryTimeout` | `30s` | Timeout when the request sets none. |
| `limits.maxQueryTimeout` | `30s` | Longest timeout a request can set. |
| `limits.maxConcurrent` | `100` | Queries running at one time. |
| `limits.disableCrossCatalog` | `false` | Reject queries that read several catalogs. |
| `limits.globalRps` | `500` | Requests per second, all clients. `0` means no limit. |
| `limits.globalBurst` | `1000` | Burst for `globalRps`. |
| `limits.perIpRps` | `0` | Requests per second per client IP. `0` means no limit. |
| `limits.perIpBurst` | `0` | Burst for `perIpRps`. |
| `limits.perIpMaxBuckets` | `10000` | Maximum client IPs tracked. |
| `limits.defaultSubjectRps` | `0` | Requests per second per subject without `rateLimit`. `0` means no limit. |
| `limits.defaultSubjectBurst` | `0` | Burst for `defaultSubjectRps`. |
| `cache.rewrite.enabled` | `false` | Cache decisions and rewritten SQL. |
| `cache.rewrite.size` | `4096` | Maximum cached entries. |
| `cache.rewrite.ttl` | `1m` | Lifetime of an entry. |
| `approval.publicBaseUrl` |  | Base URL of the accept and reject links. |
| `approval.webhooks[].url` |  | Receiver of approval requests. |
| `approval.webhooks[].headersRef` |  | Secret reference: JSON object of headers. |
| `approval.webhooks[].timeout` | `10s` | Timeout of one delivery. |
| `approval.syncWait` | `20s` | Wait for a decision before `ERR_APPROVAL_PENDING`. At most `rest.requestTimeout` minus 2 s. |
| `approval.requestTtl` | `15m` | Lifetime of a pending approval. |
| `approval.grantTtl` | `5m` | Lifetime of a grant. |
| `approval.maxPending` | `1000` | Maximum pending approvals. |
| `approval.sqlSampleBytes` | `2048` | SQL bytes in the webhook. |
| `approval.persist` | `false` | Keep approvals over a restart. |
| `approval.stateDir` | `./state` | Directory of the approval store. |
| `budget.enabled` | `false` | Turn on budgets. |
| `budget.stateDir` | `./state` | Directory of the budget store. |
| `budget.flushInterval` | `5s` | Time between writes to the store. |
| `budget.failClosed` | `true` | Stop at start when the store cannot open. |
| `budget.retentionDays` | `35` | Days of usage kept. |
